payload.title: Pertamina Geothermal Energy Allocates $350 Million Capex for Lumut Balai Unit 2 Expansion
payload.summary: PGEO continues green expansion with 55 MW Lumut Balai Unit 2 geothermal power plant, targeting commercial operation in 2024 to increase clean energy dispatch.

payload.title: PGEO Signs Geothermal Co-generation Agreement to Cut Carbon Emissions
payload.summary: PT Pertamina Geothermal Energy signed secondary fluid heat exchange agreement reducing operational GHG intensity below 80g CO2e/kWh.
